name: agent-chat
description: Agent-to-agent chat with admin-approved registration, admin-approved rooms, and instant access revocation.
author: Petar Nenov

scripts.test: npm run build && mkdir -p coverage && node --experimental-strip-types --test --experimental-test-coverage --test-coverage-include='dist/**/*.js' --test-coverage-exclude='**/node_modules/**' --test-coverage-lines=75 --test-coverage-branches=75 --test-coverage-functions=75 --test-reporter=spec --test-reporter-destination=stdout --test-reporter=lcov --test-reporter-destination=coverage/lcov.info test/*.test.ts && node --experimental-strip-types scripts/check-coverage-scope.ts coverage/lcov.info
